issue.title: test_run_workspace_git_command_recovers_stale_index_lock flakes under loaded scoped check
issue.description:
## Flake report

- **Test:** `tests/test_sase_utils.py::test_run_workspace_git_command_recovers_stale_index_lock`
- **Repro:** `sase tool run check` (scoped parallel lane), then `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_sase_utils.py::test_run_workspace_git_command_recovers_stale_index_lock -q --tb=short`

Failed once under the loaded scoped `just check` lane with `assert False is True` (`run_workspace_command` returned `success is False` after `git add` against a tmp repo that had an aged `.git/index.lock`). The same node then passed on an unchanged tree in isolation (1 passed in 2.10s). This agent did not touch git-lock recovery; the surrounding work was a TUI `_loading.py` split. Fail rate 1/2 observed; serial isolation pass; parallel/loaded check fail.

task_type_fields.evidence: Failed once in the scoped parallel check lane (assert False is True on run_workspace_command success). Passed immediately after on the same tree in isolation: 1 passed in 2.10s. Fail rate 1/2. Serial isolation pass; loaded parallel fail.

evidence.note: Landing triage of PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP from sase-1kj.8.1.3 note #3 adds a second caller of the same abandoned .git/index.lock recovery: tests/ace/tui/test_session_proc_reporter_git_lock.py::test_reporter_dev_command_runner_recovers_abandoned_ff_lock. ToolRun 3652943e582592c9f19aec77808f3907 returned 1 from git merge --ff-only; its recovery log explicitly preserved the stale lock because permission was denied reading /proc/2193656/fd. Both this reporter path (dev_update.command) and the task original core.shell caller use run_with_git_lock_retry with aged fixture locks and 0.001s retries. Same shared stale-lock remediation, not maintenance.lock copytree. Phase isolated rerun and lander rerun at d69cd499dd pass. Expand this existing investigation rather than create a duplicate; do not weaken live-lock safety.

The recovery log preserved the aged .git/index.lock because git_lock_observe could not read /proc/2778714/fd (permission denied); run_git returned 128. The exact node passed unchanged in a one-worker focused rerun, ToolRun 03a698314138047be3a67e857c073538 (5.76s). Fail/pass: 1/2; parallel fail, one-worker pass. The test touches .git/index.lock in a tmp repo, sets SASE_GIT_LOCK_RETRY_DELAYS=0.001 and expects sase.workspace_provider.plugins.bare_git_init._run_git (which wraps run_with_git_lock_retry) to remove the lock; same fixture-lock recovery shape as the core.shell, session-proc-reporter, revert_agent_git and commit-finalizer callers already recorded here. payload.entry: Fixed by epic sase-1vy phase .4 (commit 53acb952ef), completed by its land agent. Root cause was in the tests, not the product. Each caller test planted an aged index.lock, but recovery still scanned the whole host's /proc. Under load a foreign Git process with unreadable fds made the probe incomplete (permission denied), and recovery correctly preserved the lock. tests/git_lock_test_helpers.patch_git_lock_owner_probe now injects explicit owner facts at each caller's imported run_with_git_lock_retry seam. The real executor, Git and Rust policy still run, and lock paths are asserted to stay inside the temp repo. Phase .4 covered all 7 reported callers and added absent/active/permission-denied-incomplete safety coverage (active and incomplete preserve the lock bytes): 5/5 contention repeats on 19 nodes, 0 failures; check da5427b1 green. The land agent moved the 8 remaining sibling nodes with the same shape onto the helper: vcs_provider bare-git add_remove, bare-git sdd init, version._git.run_git, dev_update run_dev_update_command, sdd_store rebase, prompt-save-macro commit worker, and both conflict_resolver nodes. Each asserts its probe ran. Results: 8 passed serially, 5/5 contention repeats on CPUs 0,1 with 8 workers and 0 failures (112.6s), sase tool run check 9f2a71c8 green. Live-lock safety unchanged. sase-1s4 (a test leaving a stale lock in the real checkout) is a separate defect and stays open.
